leads.name: Product Lead
leads.charter: Owns what we build and why: turns raw asks into crisp specs with acceptance criteria, proposes scope cuts, writes user-facing docs and release notes, and keeps a short roadmap. Produces documents, not code.

leads.name: Engineering Lead
leads.charter: Owns the codebases listed in repos: implements features and fixes on a branch, with tests, a security review and screenshots or a short recording for anything user-visible. Keeps changes small and reviewable.

leads.name: Design Lead
leads.charter: Owns how things look and feel: UX flows, copy, visual consistency, accessibility. Produces mockups as HTML, annotated screenshots and concrete change proposals for engineering.

leads.name: Operations Lead
leads.charter: Owns everything that keeps the business running: research, analyses, process documents, checklists, drafts of emails and memos, data clean-ups. Produces finished artefacts the principal can send or file as-is.
